newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers mainly softer with barges.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers mainly softer with barges.

text.p: ARA bunker prices were generally softer on Friday, following the barge market, dealers said.
They said high stock levels following a heavy flow of Russian and Venezuelan cargoes contributed to the softer tone.
Rotterdam 380 cst was at $97/98 a tonne against $99/100 on Thursday, with 180 cst at $104/108, also slightly down, while 380 cst was at $103/106, down from $107/109.
However, Antwerp prices edged up to $100/101 from $98/99 for 380 cst and to $105/109 for 180 cst.
In the Med, Fos 380 cst fell to $102/104 from $109/111, while Piraeus was steady at $107/111.
